Histology Practice Exam 3: 40 Questions (Image ID focus)

Boards-style clinical vignettes built only from the Integument, Blood, Heart & Vessels, Respiratory, and Endocrine histology lectures. Many questions use micrographs taken from the lecture slides.

  • Keys: A–D or 1–4 to answer, ←/→ to move, F to flag. Click any image to enlarge it.
  • Correct answers are spread evenly across A–D (10 each) in a shuffled, non-sequential order.
